baseline_notes.c2f_svgd_fm_single_pass: pure raw-noise FlowMap proposal bank with trajectory-compatible multi-time SVGD assimilation
baseline_notes.c2f_svgd_fm_bidirectional: single-pass C2F-SVGD-FM plus blind clean-elite selection, re-noising to FlowMap time, and resumed gated assimilation
baseline_notes.unet: supervised amortized inverse map; not used by C2F-SVGD-FM
baseline_notes.pinn_unet: supervised amortized inverse map with physics loss; not used by C2F-SVGD-FM
baseline_notes.no: Neural Operator style baseline prediction; not used for initialization
baseline_notes.dps_warmstart: best visible DPS/DDPM diagnostic baseline in the included log
